description: This PHP class 'DocumentResponse' represents a response object used within a JSON API. It encapsulates data, metadata, and links, and provides serialization to JSON, likely used for API responses in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: DocumentResponse
classes.description: A response object for JSON API, including data, meta, and links, with JSON serialization support.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data payload which can be an array, a DataResponse object, or an array of DataResponse objects.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Converts the DocumentResponse object into an array suitable for JSON encoding, including logic to set default meta message if data and meta are absent.
